package magnacoda

import (
	"strconv"
	"strings"
	"testing"

	"gno.land/p/nt/uassert/v0"
)

func TestRenderHomeAndPages(cur realm, t *testing.T) {
	reset()
	realmURL = "/r/g1pzn6rn8q0pfmq4xje4j8086ncnldavyz8skgp3/magnacoda"

	empty := Render("")
	uassert.True(t, strings.Contains(empty, "Magna Coda"))
	uassert.True(t, strings.Contains(empty, "For agents"))
	uassert.True(t, strings.Contains(empty, "RegisterAgent"))
	uassert.True(t, strings.Contains(empty, "PostTask"))
	uassert.True(t, strings.Contains(empty, "PlaceBid"))
	uassert.True(t, strings.Contains(empty, "AcceptBid"))
	uassert.True(t, strings.Contains(empty, "CompleteTask"))
	uassert.True(t, strings.Contains(empty, "Rate("))
	uassert.True(t, strings.Contains(empty, "gno.land/r/g1pzn6rn8q0pfmq4xje4j8086ncnldavyz8skgp3/magnacoda"))
	uassert.True(t, strings.Contains(empty, "No agents yet"))
	uassert.True(t, strings.Contains(empty, "No open tasks"))
	uassert.True(t, strings.Contains(Render("missing"), "Not found"))

	register(cur, carol, "Research Bot", "research, writing", RateHourly, 500000)
	register(cur, bob, "Code Agent", "code, review", RateFlat, 2000000)
	openID := post(cur, alice, "Summarize a paper", "Write a one-page summary of the attached paper.", "research", 3000000)
	workID := post(cur, alice, "Review a realm", "Look over an escrow realm for footguns please.", "review", 4000000)
	bid(cur, carol, openID, 2500000, "I can summarize this")
	bid2 := bid(cur, bob, workID, 3500000, "I can review this")
	accept(cur, alice, workID, bid2)
	complete(cur, bob, workID)

	home := Render("")
	uassert.True(t, strings.Contains(home, "Research Bot"))
	uassert.True(t, strings.Contains(home, "Code Agent"))
	uassert.True(t, strings.Contains(home, "Summarize a paper"))
	uassert.True(t, strings.Contains(home, "In escrow"))
	uassert.False(t, strings.Contains(home, "Review a realm"), "completed tasks should not appear in the open list")

	agentPage := Render("agent/" + carol.String())
	uassert.True(t, strings.Contains(agentPage, "Research Bot"))
	uassert.True(t, strings.Contains(agentPage, "research, writing"))
	uassert.True(t, strings.Contains(agentPage, "Summarize a paper"))

	taskPage := Render("task/" + strconv.Itoa(openID))
	uassert.True(t, strings.Contains(taskPage, "Summarize a paper"))
	uassert.True(t, strings.Contains(taskPage, "I can summarize this"))
	uassert.True(t, strings.Contains(taskPage, "Place a bid"))
	uassert.True(t, strings.Contains(taskPage, "Cancel and refund"))

	donePage := Render("task/" + strconv.Itoa(workID))
	uassert.True(t, strings.Contains(donePage, "Completed"))
	uassert.True(t, strings.Contains(donePage, "Code Agent"))
	uassert.True(t, strings.Contains(donePage, "Escrow has been released"))
	uassert.True(t, strings.Contains(donePage, "Rate 5 stars"))

	rate(cur, alice, workID, 5, "Great review")

	home = Render("")
	uassert.True(t, strings.Contains(home, "Leaderboard"))
	uassert.True(t, strings.Contains(home, "5.00"))
	uassert.True(t, strings.Contains(home, "provisional"))

	agentPage = Render("agent/" + bob.String())
	uassert.True(t, strings.Contains(agentPage, "5.00"))
	uassert.True(t, strings.Contains(agentPage, "Great review"))
	uassert.True(t, strings.Contains(agentPage, "Rating history"))

	ratedPage := Render("task/" + strconv.Itoa(workID))
	uassert.True(t, strings.Contains(ratedPage, "5 / 5"))
	uassert.True(t, strings.Contains(ratedPage, "Great review"))

	board := Render("leaderboard")
	uassert.True(t, strings.Contains(board, "Code Agent"))
	uassert.True(t, strings.Contains(board, "5.00"))
	uassert.True(t, strings.Contains(board, "provisional"))

	about := Render("about")
	uassert.True(t, strings.Contains(about, "20%"))
	uassert.True(t, strings.Contains(about, "45-day"))
	uassert.True(t, strings.Contains(about, "no identity layer"))
	uassert.True(t, strings.Contains(about, "Hash-commit"))
	uassert.True(t, strings.Contains(Render("agents"), "Research Bot"))
	uassert.True(t, strings.Contains(Render("tasks"), "Review a realm"))
}

}

package verdict

import (
	"chain/runtime"
	"net/url"
	"strconv"
	"strings"
	"time"

	"gno.land/p/moul/txlink/v0"
	"gno.land/p/nt/markdown/sanitize/v0"
	"gno.land/p/nt/mux/v0"
	"gno.land/p/nt/seqid/v0"
)

func seqidKey(id uint64) string {
	return seqid.ID(id).String()
}

func realmLink(subpath string) string {
	prefix := strings.TrimPrefix(realmPkgPath, runtime.ChainDomain())
	return prefix + ":" + subpath
}

// safeInline escapes user-supplied text once for inline markdown slots and
// escapes literal '$' so gnoweb math mode cannot be triggered by user text.
func safeInline(s string) string {
	return strings.ReplaceAll(sanitize.InlineText(s), "$", "\\$")
}

func safeTableCell(s string) string {
	return strings.ReplaceAll(sanitize.TableCell(s), "$", "\\$")
}

func safeBlock(s string) string {
	return strings.ReplaceAll(sanitize.Block(s), "$", "\\$")
}

func formatGNOT(ugnot int64) string {
	sign := ""
	if ugnot < 0 {
		sign = "-"
		ugnot = -ugnot
	}
	whole := ugnot / 1_000_000
	frac := (ugnot % 1_000_000) / 100 // 4 decimal places
	fracStr := strconv.FormatInt(frac, 10)
	for len(fracStr) < 4 {
		fracStr = "0" + fracStr
	}
	return sign + strconv.FormatInt(whole, 10) + "." + fracStr + " GNOT"
}

func formatProbPct(bps int64) string {
	tenths := bps / 10
	whole := tenths / 10
	dec := tenths % 10
	return strconv.FormatInt(whole, 10) + "." + strconv.FormatInt(dec, 10) + "%"
}

func formatUnixTime(ts int64) string {
	return time.Unix(ts, 0).UTC().Format("2006-01-02 15:04 UTC")
}

func buildRouter() *mux.Router {
	r := mux.NewRouter()
	r.HandleFunc("", renderHome)
	r.HandleFunc("market/{id}", renderMarket)
	r.HandleFunc("create", renderCreate)
	r.HandleFunc("portfolio/{addr}", renderPortfolio)
	r.SetNotFoundHandler(renderNotFound)
	return r
}

// Render returns Gno-Flavored Markdown rendered by gnoweb for the given route.
func Render(path string) string {
	clearPath, query, hasQuery := strings.Cut(path, "?")
	clearPath = strings.Trim(clearPath, "/")
	normalized := clearPath
	if hasQuery {
		normalized = clearPath + "?" + query
	}
	return router.Render(normalized)
}

func renderHome(res *mux.ResponseWriter, req *mux.Request) {
	stats := GetStats()
	catFilter := strings.TrimSpace(req.Query.Get("cat"))
	page := 1
	if pStr := req.Query.Get("page"); pStr != "" {
		if parsed, err := strconv.Atoi(pStr); err == nil && parsed > 0 {
			page = parsed
		}
	}

	const pageSize = 10
	offset := (page - 1) * pageSize

	var sb strings.Builder
	sb.WriteString("# Verdict — On-Chain Prediction Markets\n\n")
	sb.WriteString("Permissionless binary markets powered by deterministic 128-bit CPMM math, bonded optimistic resolution, and M-of-N arbiter escalation.\n\n")

	sb.WriteString("<gno-columns>\n")
	sb.WriteString("<gno-frame>\n")
	sb.WriteString("### Markets\n\n")
	sb.WriteString("**" + strconv.Itoa(stats.MarketCount) + "** total (" + strconv.Itoa(stats.ResolvedMarketCount) + " resolved)\n")
	sb.WriteString("</gno-frame>\n")
	sb.WriteString("<gno-columns-sep />\n")
	sb.WriteString("<gno-frame>\n")
	sb.WriteString("### Collateral Locked\n\n")
	sb.WriteString("**" + formatGNOT(stats.TotalCollateral) + "**\n")
	sb.WriteString("</gno-frame>\n")
	sb.WriteString("<gno-columns-sep />\n")
	sb.WriteString("<gno-frame>\n")
	sb.WriteString("### Cumulative Volume\n\n")
	sb.WriteString("**" + formatGNOT(stats.TotalVolume) + "** (" + strconv.FormatInt(stats.TotalTrades, 10) + " trades)\n")
	sb.WriteString("</gno-frame>\n")
	sb.WriteString("</gno-columns>\n\n")

	sb.WriteString("<gno-button href=\"" + realmLink("create") + "\" label=\"+ Create Market\" variant=\"success\" /> ")
	sb.WriteString("<gno-button href=\"" + txlink.NewLink("ClaimBonds").URL() + "\" label=\"Claim My Bonds\" variant=\"outline\" />\n\n")

	if catFilter != "" {
		sb.WriteString("Filtered by category: **" + safeInline(catFilter) + "** — [Clear filter](" + realmLink("?page=1") + ")\n\n")
	}

	sb.WriteString("## Active & Recent Markets\n\n")

	all := ListMarkets(offset, pageSize)
	if len(all) == 0 {
		sb.WriteString("> [!NOTE]\n")
		sb.WriteString("> No markets found on this page yet. Create the first binary market using the button above.\n")
		res.Write(sb.String())
		return
	}

	sb.WriteString("| ID | Question | Category | Status | YES / NO | Odds Bar | Liquidity | Volume |\n")
	sb.WriteString("| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |\n")

	shown := 0
	for _, m := range all {
		if catFilter != "" && !strings.EqualFold(m.Category, catFilter) {
			continue
		}
		shown++
		idStr := strconv.FormatUint(m.ID, 10)
		qLink := "[#" + idStr + " " + safeTableCell(m.Question) + "](" + realmLink("market/"+idStr) + ")"
		catLink := "[" + safeTableCell(m.Category) + "](" + realmLink("?cat="+url.QueryEscape(m.Category)) + ")"
		odds := "**" + formatProbPct(m.YesProbBps) + "** / " + formatProbPct(m.NoProbBps)
		bar := renderMiniOddsBarMarkdown(m.YesProbBps)
		statusStr := m.StatusLabel
		if m.Status == StatusResolved {
			statusStr = "RESOLVED (" + m.FinalOutcomeLabel + ")"
		}
		sb.WriteString("| " + idStr + " | " + qLink + " | " + catLink + " | " + statusStr + " | " + odds + " | " + bar + " | " + formatGNOT(m.Collateral) + " | " + formatGNOT(m.TotalVolume) + " |\n")
	}

	if shown == 0 {
		sb.WriteString("| - | No matching markets in this category | - | - | - | - | - | - |\n")
	}

	sb.WriteString("\n")
	if page > 1 {
		sb.WriteString("[Previous Page](" + realmLink("?page="+strconv.Itoa(page-1)) + ")  ")
	}
	if len(all) == pageSize {
		sb.WriteString("[Next Page](" + realmLink("?page="+strconv.Itoa(page+1)) + ")")
	}
	sb.WriteString("\n")

	res.Write(sb.String())
}

func renderMarket(res *mux.ResponseWriter, req *mux.Request) {
	idStr := req.GetVar("id")
	id, err := strconv.ParseUint(idStr, 10, 64)
	if err != nil || id == 0 {
		renderNotFound(res, req)
		return
	}
	m := getMarketOrNil(id)
	if m == nil {
		renderNotFound(res, req)
		return
	}

	var sb strings.Builder
	sb.WriteString("[← Back to All Markets](" + realmLink("") + ")\n\n")
	sb.WriteString("# #" + idStr + " — " + safeInline(m.question) + "\n\n")
	sb.WriteString("**Category:** `" + safeInline(m.category) + "` · **Creator:** " + m.creator.String() + " · **Closes:** `" + formatUnixTime(m.closeTime) + "` · **Fee:** `" + formatProbPct(m.pool.FeeBps) + "`\n\n")

	if m.description != "" {
		sb.WriteString(safeBlock(m.description))
	}

	sb.WriteString(renderOddsChartMarkdown(m.priceHistory, m.pool.YesProbBps(), m.status, m.finalOutcome) + "\n\n")

	sb.WriteString("<gno-columns>\n")
	sb.WriteString("<gno-frame>\n")
	sb.WriteString("### YES Odds\n\n")
	sb.WriteString("**" + formatProbPct(m.pool.YesProbBps()) + "**\n\nPool YES reserve: `" + formatGNOT(m.pool.ReserveYes) + "`\n")
	sb.WriteString("</gno-frame>\n")
	sb.WriteString("<gno-columns-sep />\n")
	sb.WriteString("<gno-frame>\n")
	sb.WriteString("### NO Odds\n\n")
	sb.WriteString("**" + formatProbPct(m.pool.NoProbBps()) + "**\n\nPool NO reserve: `" + formatGNOT(m.pool.ReserveNo) + "`\n")
	sb.WriteString("</gno-frame>\n")
	sb.WriteString("<gno-columns-sep />\n")
	sb.WriteString("<gno-frame>\n")
	sb.WriteString("### Liquidity & Fees\n\n")
	sb.WriteString("Collateral: `" + formatGNOT(m.collateral) + "`\n\nLP Fees: `" + formatGNOT(m.feePool) + "`\n")
	sb.WriteString("</gno-frame>\n")
	sb.WriteString("</gno-columns>\n\n")

	now := time.Now().Unix()
	switch m.status {
	case StatusOpen:
		if now < m.closeTime {
			sb.WriteString("> [!INFO] Market Open for Trading\n")
			sb.WriteString("> Quick actions below prefill 1 GNOT `MsgCall` transactions, or use the Sell form.\n\n")

			buyYesURL := txlink.NewLink("Buy").AddArgs("marketID", idStr, "buyYes", "true", "minSharesOut", "1").SetSend("1000000ugnot").URL()
			buyNoURL := txlink.NewLink("Buy").AddArgs("marketID", idStr, "buyYes", "false", "minSharesOut", "1").SetSend("1000000ugnot").URL()
			addLPURL := txlink.NewLink("AddLiquidity").AddArgs("marketID", idStr, "minLPMinted", "1").SetSend("1000000ugnot").URL()

			sb.WriteString("<gno-button href=\"" + buyYesURL + "\" label=\"Buy YES (1 GNOT)\" variant=\"success\" /> ")
			sb.WriteString("<gno-button href=\"" + buyNoURL + "\" label=\"Buy NO (1 GNOT)\" variant=\"caution\" /> ")
			sb.WriteString("<gno-button href=\"" + addLPURL + "\" label=\"Add Liquidity (1 GNOT)\" variant=\"outline\" />\n\n")

			sb.WriteString("### Sell Outcome Shares\n\n")
			sb.WriteString("<gno-form exec=\"Sell\">\n")
			sb.WriteString("  <gno-input name=\"marketID\" type=\"number\" value=\"" + idStr + "\" readonly=\"true\" placeholder=\"Market ID\" />\n")
			sb.WriteString("  <gno-select name=\"sellYes\" value=\"true\" selected=\"true\" description=\"true = Sell YES shares, false = Sell NO shares\" />\n")
			sb.WriteString("  <gno-select name=\"sellYes\" value=\"false\" />\n")
			sb.WriteString("  <gno-input name=\"sharesIn\" type=\"number\" placeholder=\"Shares to sell (ugnot units)\" required=\"true\" />\n")
			sb.WriteString("  <gno-input name=\"minCollateralOut\" type=\"number\" value=\"0\" placeholder=\"Min ugnot payout (slippage guard)\" required=\"true\" />\n")
			sb.WriteString("</gno-form>\n\n")
		} else {
			bondSend := strconv.FormatInt(m.bondAmount, 10) + Denom
			sb.WriteString("> [!WARNING] Market Closed — Ready for Optimistic Proposal\n")
			sb.WriteString("> Anyone may propose the final outcome by posting a refundable **" + formatGNOT(m.bondAmount) + "** bond.\n\n")

			propYesURL := txlink.NewLink("ProposeOutcome").AddArgs("marketID", idStr, "outcome", "1").SetSend(bondSend).URL()
			propNoURL := txlink.NewLink("ProposeOutcome").AddArgs("marketID", idStr, "outcome", "2").SetSend(bondSend).URL()
			propInvURL := txlink.NewLink("ProposeOutcome").AddArgs("marketID", idStr, "outcome", "3").SetSend(bondSend).URL()

			sb.WriteString("<gno-button href=\"" + propYesURL + "\" label=\"Propose YES\" variant=\"success\" /> ")
			sb.WriteString("<gno-button href=\"" + propNoURL + "\" label=\"Propose NO\" variant=\"caution\" /> ")
			sb.WriteString("<gno-button href=\"" + propInvURL + "\" label=\"Propose INVALID\" variant=\"outline\" />\n\n")
		}

	case StatusProposed:
		sb.WriteString("> [!WARNING] Outcome Proposed: " + m.proposedOutcome.String() + "\n")
		sb.WriteString("> Proposed by " + m.proposer.String() + " with bond **" + formatGNOT(m.proposerBond) + "**. Dispute deadline: `" + formatUnixTime(m.disputeDeadline) + "`.\n\n")

		if now < m.disputeDeadline {
			bondSend := strconv.FormatInt(m.bondAmount, 10) + Denom
			disputeURL := txlink.NewLink("DisputeOutcome").AddArgs("marketID", idStr).SetSend(bondSend).URL()
			sb.WriteString("<gno-button href=\"" + disputeURL + "\" label=\"Dispute Proposal (" + formatGNOT(m.bondAmount) + " Bond)\" variant=\"caution\" />\n\n")
		} else {
			finalizeURL := txlink.NewLink("FinalizeResolution").AddArgs("marketID", idStr).URL()
			sb.WriteString("<gno-button href=\"" + finalizeURL + "\" label=\"Finalize Resolution\" variant=\"success\" />\n\n")
		}

	case StatusDisputed:
		sb.WriteString("> [!CAUTION] Outcome Disputed — Arbiter Quorum Active\n")
		sb.WriteString("> Disputer: " + m.disputer.String() + " · Votes (YES/NO/INVALID): `" + strconv.Itoa(m.yesVotes) + "/" + strconv.Itoa(m.noVotes) + "/" + strconv.Itoa(m.invalidVotes) + "` (quorum: `" + strconv.Itoa(m.arbiterQuorum) + "`).\n\n")

		voteYesURL := txlink.NewLink("CastArbiterVote").AddArgs("marketID", idStr, "outcome", "1").URL()
		voteNoURL := txlink.NewLink("CastArbiterVote").AddArgs("marketID", idStr, "outcome", "2").URL()
		voteInvURL := txlink.NewLink("CastArbiterVote").AddArgs("marketID", idStr, "outcome", "3").URL()
		sb.WriteString("<gno-button href=\"" + voteYesURL + "\" label=\"Arbiter Vote YES\" variant=\"success\" /> ")
		sb.WriteString("<gno-button href=\"" + voteNoURL + "\" label=\"Arbiter Vote NO\" variant=\"caution\" /> ")
		sb.WriteString("<gno-button href=\"" + voteInvURL + "\" label=\"Arbiter Vote INVALID\" variant=\"outline\" />\n\n")

		if now >= m.disputedAt+ArbiterTimeout {
			expURL := txlink.NewLink("ExpireDispute").AddArgs("marketID", idStr).URL()
			sb.WriteString("<gno-button href=\"" + expURL + "\" label=\"Expire Stalled Dispute (INVALID)\" variant=\"warning\" />\n\n")
		}

	case StatusResolved:
		sb.WriteString("> [!SUCCESS] Resolved: " + m.finalOutcome.String() + "\n")
		sb.WriteString("> Finalized at `" + formatUnixTime(m.resolvedAt) + "`. Winning shareholders and LPs can claim payouts below.\n\n")

		claimURL := txlink.NewLink("Claim").AddArgs("marketID", idStr).URL()
		claimBondsURL := txlink.NewLink("ClaimBonds").URL()
		sb.WriteString("<gno-button href=\"" + claimURL + "\" label=\"Claim Market Payout\" variant=\"success\" /> ")
		sb.WriteString("<gno-button href=\"" + claimBondsURL + "\" label=\"Claim Bonds\" variant=\"outline\" />\n\n")
	}

	sb.WriteString("## Share Supply & Resolution Summary\n\n")
	sb.WriteString("| Metric | Value |\n")
	sb.WriteString("| :--- | :--- |\n")
	sb.WriteString("| Outstanding YES Shares | " + formatGNOT(m.totalYesOut) + " |\n")
	sb.WriteString("| Outstanding NO Shares | " + formatGNOT(m.totalNoOut) + " |\n")
	sb.WriteString("| Total LP Supply | " + formatGNOT(m.pool.TotalLP) + " |\n")
	sb.WriteString("| Total Volume | " + formatGNOT(m.totalVolume) + " |\n")
	sb.WriteString("| Trades | " + strconv.FormatInt(m.tradeCount, 10) + " |\n")
	sb.WriteString("| Required Resolution Bond | " + formatGNOT(m.bondAmount) + " |\n")

	res.Write(sb.String())
}

func renderCreate(res *mux.ResponseWriter, _ *mux.Request) {
	sampleClose := strconv.FormatInt(time.Now().Unix()+7*86400, 10)
	createURL := txlink.NewLink("CreateMarket").
		AddArgs(
			"question", "Will Gno.land ship v1.9 before 2027?",
			"description", "Resolves YES if gnolang/gno tags v1.9.0 or higher before Jan 1, 2027 UTC.",
			"category", "Ecosystem",
			"closeTimeUnix", sampleClose,
			"feeBps", "100",
			"disputeWindowSec", "3600",
		).
		SetSend("1000000ugnot").
		URL()

	var sb strings.Builder
	sb.WriteString("[← Back to All Markets](" + realmLink("") + ")\n\n")
	sb.WriteString("# Create a Binary Market\n\n")
	sb.WriteString("Anyone can launch a new 50/50 CPMM prediction market via `CreateMarket` by attaching at least **0.1 GNOT** (`100000ugnot`).\n\n")
	sb.WriteString("<gno-button href=\"" + createURL + "\" label=\"Launch Sample Market (1 GNOT Seed)\" variant=\"success\" />\n\n")
	sb.WriteString("## Parameter Bounds\n\n")
	sb.WriteString("| Parameter | Constraint |\n")
	sb.WriteString("| :--- | :--- |\n")

	sb.WriteString("| `description` | 0–1000 chars |\n")
	sb.WriteString("| `category` | 1–32 chars |\n")
	sb.WriteString("| `closeTimeUnix` | `[now + 60s, now + 365d]` |\n")
	sb.WriteString("| `feeBps` | `0–1000` (0%–10% LP fee) |\n")

	sb.WriteString("| `-send` deposit | `>= 100000ugnot` |\n")
	res.Write(sb.String())

func renderPortfolio(res *mux.ResponseWriter, req *mux.Request) {
	rawAddr := strings.TrimSpace(req.GetVar("addr"))
	addr := address(rawAddr)
	if !addr.IsValid() {
		var sb strings.Builder
		sb.WriteString("[← Back to All Markets](" + realmLink("") + ")\n\n")
		sb.WriteString("> [!WARNING] Invalid Address\n")
		sb.WriteString("> `" + safeInline(rawAddr) + "` is not a valid Gno address.\n")
		res.Write(sb.String())
		return
	}

	var sb strings.Builder
	sb.WriteString("[← Back to All Markets](" + realmLink("") + ")\n\n")
	sb.WriteString("# Portfolio — " + addr.String() + "\n\n")

	bonds := GetClaimableBonds(addr)
	sb.WriteString("**Claimable Dispute/Resolution Bonds:** `" + formatGNOT(bonds) + "`")
	if bonds > 0 {
		sb.WriteString(" — <gno-button href=\"" + txlink.NewLink("ClaimBonds").URL() + "\" label=\"Claim Bonds\" variant=\"success\" />")
	}
	sb.WriteString("\n\n")

	recent := ListMarkets(0, MaxPageLimit)
	var rows strings.Builder
	count := 0
	for _, m := range recent {
		pos := GetPosition(m.ID, addr)
		if pos.YesShares == 0 && pos.NoShares == 0 && pos.LPShares == 0 && pos.PendingFees == 0 && !pos.Claimed {
			continue
		}
		count++
		idStr := strconv.FormatUint(m.ID, 10)
		action := "-"
		if m.Status == StatusResolved && !pos.Claimed && pos.EstClaimable > 0 {
			claimURL := txlink.NewLink("Claim").AddArgs("marketID", idStr).URL()
			action = "[Claim " + formatGNOT(pos.EstClaimable) + "](" + claimURL + ")"
		} else if pos.Claimed {
			action = "Claimed"
		}
		rows.WriteString("| [#" + idStr + " " + safeTableCell(m.Question) + "](" + realmLink("market/"+idStr) + ") | " + m.StatusLabel + " | " + formatGNOT(pos.YesShares) + " | " + formatGNOT(pos.NoShares) + " | " + formatGNOT(pos.LPShares) + " | " + formatGNOT(pos.PendingFees) + " | " + action + " |\n")
	}

	if count == 0 {
		sb.WriteString("> [!NOTE]\n")
		sb.WriteString("> No active or historical positions found across recent markets.\n")
	} else {
		sb.WriteString("| Market | Status | YES | NO | LP | LP Fees | Action |\n")
		sb.WriteString("| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |\n")
		sb.WriteString(rows.String())
	}
	res.Write(sb.String())
}

func renderNotFound(res *mux.ResponseWriter, req *mux.Request) {
	var sb strings.Builder
	sb.WriteString("> [!WARNING] Route Not Found\n")
	sb.WriteString("> Unknown path `" + safeInline(req.Path) + "`.\n\n")
	sb.WriteString("[Return to Verdict Home](" + realmLink("") + ")\n")
	res.Write(sb.String())
}

	ArbiterTimeout int64 = 7 * 86400

// MarketStatus represents the lifecycle state of a prediction market.
type MarketStatus uint8

const (
	StatusOpen     MarketStatus = 0
	StatusProposed MarketStatus = 1
	StatusDisputed MarketStatus = 2
	StatusResolved MarketStatus = 3
)

// String returns a human-readable market status label.
func (s MarketStatus) String() string {
	switch s {
	case StatusOpen:
		return "OPEN"
	case StatusProposed:
		return "PROPOSED"
	case StatusDisputed:
		return "DISPUTED"
	case StatusResolved:
		return "RESOLVED"
	default:
		return "UNKNOWN"
	}
}

// Outcome represents the resolution state of a binary market.
type Outcome uint8

const (
	OutcomeUnresolved Outcome = 0
	OutcomeYes        Outcome = 1
	OutcomeNo         Outcome = 2
	OutcomeInvalid    Outcome = 3
)

// ValidResolution reports whether o is a terminal resolution outcome (YES, NO, or INVALID).
func (o Outcome) ValidResolution() bool {
	return o == OutcomeYes || o == OutcomeNo || o == OutcomeInvalid
}

// String returns a human-readable outcome label.
func (o Outcome) String() string {
	switch o {
	case OutcomeUnresolved:
		return "UNRESOLVED"
	case OutcomeYes:
		return "YES"
	case OutcomeNo:
		return "NO"
	case OutcomeInvalid:
		return "INVALID"
	default:
		return "UNKNOWN"
	}
}

	ProposerBond       int64
	Disputer           address

	FinalOutcome       Outcome

	RemainingWinShares int64

	NoShares     int64

# 🍺 Tavern Board — Open Task Board with GNOT Escrow

> **Gnome Tavern Hackathon | Gno.land** — built on the Onyx testnet (`onyx-1`).
> Live realm: https://onyx.testnets.gno.land/r/g1vcx5jucedrvyr8wr9u5y69zw5eq6u779k54stc/tavernboard
> Realm path: `gno.land/r/g1vcx5jucedrvyr8wr9u5y69zw5eq6u779k54stc/tavernboard`

Post a task, lock its reward in escrow, and let anyone in the tavern claim it.
The worker submits proof, you approve, and the escrow pays out — all on-chain,
no middleman, no frontend server. The board itself is the UI: gnoweb renders
it straight from the realm.

## How it works

1. **Post** a task with GNOT attached (`-send`) — the reward is escrowed in the realm.
2. **Claim** an open task (anyone except the poster).
3. **Submit proof** of the work (text + link).
4. **Approve** — the poster releases the escrow to the worker.
5. If a deadline passes unfinished, **anyone** can release the escrow back to
   the poster (`ReleaseExpired`). Funds can never be locked forever.

Side paths: the poster can `RejectProof` (worker may resubmit), `CancelTask`
an open task (full refund), and the worker can `Unclaim` before submitting
proof. Every ugnot obeys one invariant:

```
locked + paid + refunded == deposited
```

The `/stats` route of the realm checks it live, two independent ways.

## Try it (Onyx testnet)

Get free testnet GNOT at https://faucet.gno.land (paste your `g1...`
address, pick Onyx). 1 GNOT = 1,000,000 ugnot.

```bash
# 1. Post a task with a 5 GNOT escrow (deadline 0 = none)
gnokey maketx call -pkgpath "gno.land/r/g1vcx5jucedrvyr8wr9u5y69zw5eq6u779k54stc/tavernboard" \
  -func "PostTask" -args "Write a README for my realm" -args "One page, English, with setup steps" -args "0" \
  -send 5000000ugnot -gas-fee 2000ugnot -gas-wanted 2000000 \
  -chainid onyx-1 -remote https://rpc.onyx.testnets.gno.land:443 <your-key>

# 2. Claim it (another key)
gnokey maketx call -pkgpath "gno.land/r/g1vcx5jucedrvyr8wr9u5y69zw5eq6u779k54stc/tavernboard" \
  -func "ClaimTask" -args "1" \
  -gas-fee 2000ugnot -gas-wanted 2000000 \
  -chainid onyx-1 -remote https://rpc.onyx.testnets.gno.land:443 <your-key>

# 3. Submit proof (worker)
gnokey maketx call -pkgpath "gno.land/r/g1vcx5jucedrvyr8wr9u5y69zw5eq6u779k54stc/tavernboard" \
  -func "SubmitProof" -args "1" -args "Done: https://github.com/example/repo/pull/7" \
  -gas-fee 2000ugnot -gas-wanted 2000000 \
  -chainid onyx-1 -remote https://rpc.onyx.testnets.gno.land:443 <your-key>

# 4. Approve (poster) — escrow pays the worker
gnokey maketx call -pkgpath "gno.land/r/g1vcx5jucedrvyr8wr9u5y69zw5eq6u779k54stc/tavernboard" \
  -func "Approve" -args "1" \
  -gas-fee 2000ugnot -gas-wanted 2000000 \
  -chainid onyx-1 -remote https://rpc.onyx.testnets.gno.land:443 <your-key>
```

Read-only queries (no gas, no key):

```bash
gnokey query vm/qeval -remote https://rpc.onyx.testnets.gno.land:443 \
  -data 'gno.land/r/g1vcx5jucedrvyr8wr9u5y69zw5eq6u779k54stc/tavernboard.TaskCount()'
gnokey query vm/qeval -remote https://rpc.onyx.testnets.gno.land:443 \
  -data 'gno.land/r/g1vcx5jucedrvyr8wr9u5y69zw5eq6u779k54stc/tavernboard.Stats()'
```

Full command reference: open the realm's **Guide** route in gnoweb
(`.../tavernboard:guide`).

## Files

| File | What it is |
|---|---|
| `gnomod.toml` | Module declaration (`gno.land/r/.../tavernboard`) |
| `tavernboard.gno` | Realm: state machine, 8 crossing + 4 read-only functions, escrow + invariant |
| `render.gno` | `Render()` — gnoweb UI: home, `task/<id>`, `stats`, `guide`; input sanitizing |
| `tavernboard_test.gno` | 10 test suites: happy path, refunds, expiry, role guards, validation, Render, conservation |
| `docs/ARCHITECTURE.md` | State machine, invariant, threat model, security checklist |
| `docs/DEMO-SCRIPT.md` | Shot-by-shot script for the 1–3 min demo video |
| `scripts/deploy-onyx.sh` | Deploy to Onyx + verify it is live |
| `scripts/demo-flow.sh` | End-to-end demo transactions (post → claim → proof → approve + cancel) |
| `VERIFICATION.md` | What was tested, results, and live testnet evidence |

## Develop & test locally

Requires the [Gno toolchain](https://docs.gno.land/builders/install/)
(`gno`, `gnokey`, `gnodev` v1.8.0) and a checkout of `github.com/gnolang/gno`
for the stdlib (`-root-dir`).

```bash
export GNOROOT=$HOME/.gno/src   # path to the gno repo checkout
gno fmt ./...
gno test -v -root-dir $GNOROOT .
gnodev .                          # local devnet + hot reload at http://localhost:8888
```

Test coverage: 10 suites, all passing (`gno test -v .`).
See `VERIFICATION.md` for the full list and the live testnet evidence.

## Security design (summary)

- Caller identity always comes from `cur.Previous().Address()` — never from a parameter.
- `PostTask` (the only payable function) additionally requires a direct user
  call (`IsUserCall()`) and reads the attached amount from
  `unsafe.OriginSend()` — the reward cannot be faked.
- Checks-Effects-Interactions everywhere coins move: state + accounting
  first, `banker.SendCoins` last.
- Getters return value copies, never pointers to mutable state.
- User text is sanitized before it reaches Markdown (`Render`).
- Full checklist + threat model: `docs/ARCHITECTURE.md`.

## Why a task board

Gno.land already has escrow (MilestoneEscrow, bilateral) and forums (Boards,
no money) — but no open marketplace where anyone can post paid micro-work
with escrow. Tavern Board is that missing piece, built the way the ecosystem
itself works: one realm, gnoweb as the frontend, ugnot as the money.

# Verification — Tavern Board

How every claim about this project was checked, what passed, what is
still pending, and the exact evidence. Written 28 Nov 2026 (WIB).

## 1. What is verified (done)

### 1.1 Toolchain (28 Nov 2026)

- Installed the official prebuilt Gno toolchain via
  `misc/install.sh` from `github.com/gnolang/gno` (script downloaded,
  inspected, then run; sha256 verified by the installer itself).
- `gno version` → **v1.8.0**; `gnokey version` → **v1.8.0**.
- A sparse checkout of the Gno repo at `~/.gno/src` (stdlib +
  `gnovm/tests/stdlibs` + `examples`) is required because the prebuilt
  `gno` binary looks for the stdlib at its build-time path
  (`/__w/gno/gno`). Used via `GNOROOT=$HOME/.gno/src` and
  `gno test -root-dir $HOME/.gno/src`.

### 1.2 Unit tests — 10/10 PASS

Command (from the project dir):

```bash
export GNOROOT=$HOME/.gno/src
gno test -v -root-dir $GNOROOT .
```

Result: **all 10 suites PASS, `ok . 4.10s`** (last run 28 Nov 2026):

| Suite | What it proves |
|---|---|
| `TestHappyPathPostClaimProofApprove` | post → claim → proof → approve; worker balance +5,000,000 ugnot exactly; locked → 0; invariant holds after every step |
| `TestCancelRefundsPoster` | cancel refunds the poster +2,000,000 ugnot exactly; locked → 0 |
| `TestExpiredRefund` | release before deadline panics; after `SkipHeights(150)` the refund succeeds; no-deadline and already-settled tasks cannot be released |
| `TestRoleGuards` | poster cannot claim own task; non-worker cannot submit/unclaim; non-poster cannot approve/reject; double-approve panics; cancel of a claimed task panics; non-poster cancel panics |
| `TestRejectAndResubmit` | reject returns task to CLAIMED with proof cleared; resubmit + approve completes |
| `TestUnclaimReopens` | unclaim re-opens the task with no worker; another user can then claim it |
| `TestPostValidation` | zero reward, empty title, empty description, past deadline, missing task id all panic |
| `TestListTasksAndStats` | newest-first ordering, status filter, limit, and all 10 `Stats()` counters |
| `TestRenderAndSanitize` | home/task/stats/guide routes render; `2.5 GNOT` formatting; `\|`, `[markdown]`, backticks in user titles are escaped; stats shows invariant PASS; unknown route → 404 |
| `TestConservationAcrossMixedFlow` | one paid + one cancelled + one expired + one open task: deposited 10,000,000 = paid 1,000,000 + refunded 5,000,000 + locked 4,000,000; both invariant computations agree |

Also: `gno fmt` clean, `gno lint` clean (no findings).

### 1.3 Local devnet smoke test (gnodev, 28 Nov 2026)

- `gnodev .` started cleanly; gnoweb at `http://localhost:8888`.
- Home page rendered: "Live Board Snapshot", "Escrowed right now",
  "Current block height", "No open tasks right now".
- Stats route (`:stats`) rendered: "Conservation invariant" +
  "Invariant holds".
- gnodev stopped afterwards; ports 8888/26657 free.

### 1.4 Onyx testnet reachability (28 Nov 2026)

- `https://rpc.onyx.testnets.gno.land:443/status` answers (JSON-RPC).
  Confirmed live via the proxy on 28 Nov 2026: network `onyx-1`,
  latest height **1,460,220**, `catching_up: false`.
- `https://onyx.testnets.gno.land/` answers HTTP 200.
- `https://faucet.gno.land` answers HTTP 200; Onyx faucet
  `https://faucet.onyx.testnets.gno.land/health` answers HTTP 200.
- `gnokey query vm/qeval` through the local proxy (see §1.5) returns a
  real value (`wugnot.BalanceOf(...)` → `(0 int64)`).
- Both dev keys have **zero balance** (accounts do not exist on-chain
  yet — expected before faucet funding):
  - poster `g1vcx5jucedrvyr8wr9u5y69zw5eq6u779k54stc` → empty
  - worker `g1lf8eme0xwh272yyax7kgcf3w43myedy90cg2rr` → empty

### 1.5 gnokey ↔ Onyx proxy (needed on this VM)

`gnokey`'s tm2 client ignores the VM's egress CONNECT proxy, so direct
TLS to the public RPC fails (`tls: first record does not look like a TLS
handshake`). Fix (in this repo, `scripts/gno-rpc-proxy.py`): a local
plain-HTTP reverse proxy on `127.0.0.1:26657` that forwards to
`https://rpc.onyx.testnets.gno.land:443` via the egress proxy from the
environment. Verified working: balance/qeval queries succeed through it
(3/3 consecutive `qeval` calls after a retry fix — see below).
`scripts/deploy-onyx.sh` and `scripts/demo-flow.sh` default to it
(`GNO_REMOTE` overrides) and fail fast with instructions if it is not
running. Start it with:

```bash
python3 scripts/gno-rpc-proxy.py   # leave running in the background
```

Note: the egress proxy is flaky (occasional failed CONNECTs); the proxy
retries each request up to 3 times, and its credentials are fixed at
process start — if requests start failing with 502s after a long time,
restart the proxy to pick up fresh credentials.

### 1.6 Key findings about Gno testing (documented, not hidden)

Three behaviors of `gno test` v1.8.0 were found empirically (with probe
tests) and are now encoded in the test helpers — future maintainers must
not "simplify" them away:

1. **Caller switching is frame-scoped.** `testing.SetRealm` overrides
   the `cur` realm of the *frame that calls it directly*. A helper that
   switches the caller and returns leaves the test frame's `cur`
   unchanged. Every test helper therefore takes `cur realm` as its first
   parameter, calls `SetOriginCaller`/`SetRealm` directly (no extra
   helper layer in between), and makes its `cross(cur)` call inside
   itself.
2. **Simulated `-send` must target the package address derived from the
   realm path** (`chain.PackageAddress(RealmPath)`), not `cur.Address()`:
   after the first switch, `cur` points at a user realm, so the
   simulated send would go user → user (self-send) and the realm's real
   bank balance would stay zero while accounting claims the escrow
   exists. Symptom before the fix: `Approve` failed with
   `source address <realm> has ; cannot send ...`.
3. **`revive()` only recovers panics from crossing calls** in this
   version. A panic from a plain (non-crossing) function such as
   `GetTask` propagates uncaught and fails the test — even a bare
   `panic("boom")` inside `revive` is not caught. Negative tests
   therefore go through crossing helpers; the `GetTask(999)` case was
   removed (its `mustTask` code path is already covered by the
   "claim missing task" case).

package bouncer

	adminAddr = testutils.TestAddress("admin")
	botAddr   = testutils.TestAddress("bot")
	alice     = testutils.TestAddress("alice")
	bob       = testutils.TestAddress("bob")
)

// reset gives each test fresh state with a known admin.
func reset() {
	admin = adminAddr
	attesters = avl.NewTree()
	attesters.Set(string(adminAddr), true)
	requests = avl.NewTree()
	openByRequester = avl.NewTree()
	openRequests = avl.NewTree()
	openByPkg = avl.NewTree()
	requestID = 0
	records = avl.NewTree()
	byAuthor = avl.NewTree()
	families = avl.NewTree()
	disputes = avl.NewTree()
	disputesByPkg = avl.NewTree()
	openDisputes = avl.NewTree()
	openByFiler = avl.NewTree()
	openToRescan = avl.NewTree()
	disputeID = 0
	recent = nil
	census, hasCensus = Census{}, false
	totalFindings, totalProven = 0, 0
}

// testing.SetRealm applies to the frame that calls it, so it is called
// inline right before each crossing call, never from a helper.

func hash(c string) string { return strings.Repeat(c, 64) }

// fund makes the next call carry a dispute deposit, credited to this realm
// as a real MsgCall -send would.
func fund() {
	coins := chain.Coins{{"ugnot", DisputeDeposit}}
	testing.SetOriginSend(coins)
	testing.IssueCoins(chain.PackageAddress(selfPath), coins)
}

// rest is what OpenDisputesText lists for an attestation made by attest().
var rest = hash("a") + " " + hash("b") + " 0.1.0 master.1+f0f9c70"

func balance(addr address) int64 {
	return banker.NewReadonlyBanker().GetCoin(addr, "ugnot")
}

// attest posts an attestation as the bot (which must be an attester).
func attest(cur realm, pkgpath, report, findings, deps string) {
	testing.SetRealm(testing.NewUserRealm(botAddr))
	Attest(cross(cur), pkgpath, hash("a"), "0.1.0", hash("b"), "master.1+f0f9c70", report, "ipfs://bafyexample", findings, deps)
}

func addBot(cur realm) {
	testing.SetRealm(testing.NewUserRealm(adminAddr))
	AddAttester(cross(cur), botAddr)
}

func TestScoreFormula(t *testing.T) {
	f := func(rule, sev, label string) Finding {
		return Finding{Rule: rule, Severity: sev, Label: label, File: "a.gno", Line: 1}
	}
	cases := []struct {
		name    string
		fs      []Finding
		deps    Deps
		score   int
		grade   string
		verdict string
	}{
		{"clean", nil, Deps{}, 100, "A", VerdictClear},
		{"proven critical", []Finding{f("B05", SeverityCritical, LabelProven)}, Deps{}, 60, "C", VerdictNotRecommended},
		{"proven high", []Finding{f("B01", SeverityHigh, LabelProven)}, Deps{}, 75, "B", VerdictNotRecommended},
		{"high warning", []Finding{f("B01", SeverityHigh, LabelNotReproduced)}, Deps{}, 90, "A", VerdictReview},
		{"critical static warning", []Finding{f("B03", SeverityCritical, LabelStaticWarning)}, Deps{}, 85, "B", VerdictReview},
		{"medium only", []Finding{f("B04", SeverityMedium, LabelStaticWarning)}, Deps{}, 95, "A", VerdictClear},
		{"mixed with deps", []Finding{
			f("B05", SeverityCritical, LabelProven),      // 40
			f("B01", SeverityHigh, LabelNotReproduced),   // 10
			f("B04", SeverityMedium, LabelStaticWarning), // 5
		}, Deps{DirectAtRisk: 1, IndirectAtRisk: 1, Unverified: 1}, 28, "F", VerdictNotRecommended}, // 100-55-10-5-2
		{"unverified capped at 10", nil, Deps{Unverified: 7}, 90, "A", VerdictClear},
		{"floor at zero", []Finding{
			f("B05", SeverityCritical, LabelProven),
			f("B05", SeverityCritical, LabelProven),
			f("B05", SeverityCritical, LabelProven),
		}, Deps{}, 0, "F", VerdictNotRecommended},
		{"grade D", []Finding{f("B01", SeverityHigh, LabelProven), f("B01", SeverityHigh, LabelProven), f("B04", SeverityMedium, LabelStaticWarning)}, Deps{}, 45, "D", VerdictNotRecommended},
	}
	for _, c := range cases {
		score, grade, verdict := ScoreFor(c.fs, c.deps)
		if score != c.score || grade != c.grade || verdict != c.verdict {
			t.Errorf("%s: got %d %s %s, want %d %s %s", c.name, score, grade, verdict, c.score, c.grade, c.verdict)
		}
	}
}

func TestAttest(cur realm, t *testing.T) {
	reset()
	testing.SetRealm(testing.NewUserRealm(alice))
	reqID := RequestScan(cross(cur), "gno.land/r/demo/vault")

	testing.SetRealm(testing.NewUserRealm(bob))
	uassert.AbortsWithMessage(t, cur, "attester only", func() {
		Attest(cross(cur), "gno.land/r/demo/vault", hash("a"), "0.1.0", hash("b"), "x", hash("c"), "ipfs://cid", "", "")
	})
	testing.SetRealm(testing.NewUserRealm(bob))
	uassert.AbortsWithMessage(t, cur, "admin only", func() { AddAttester(cross(cur), bob) })
	addBot(cur)

	attest(cur, "gno.land/r/demo/vault", hash("c"), "B01,high,PROVEN,vault.gno,64;B05,critical,PROVEN,vault.gno,35", "")
	a, ok := Latest("gno.land/r/demo/vault")
	urequire.True(t, ok)
	uassert.Equal(t, 35, a.Score) // 100 - 25 - 40
	uassert.Equal(t, "F", a.Grade)
	uassert.Equal(t, VerdictNotRecommended, a.Verdict)
	uassert.Equal(t, botAddr, a.Attester)
	urequire.Equal(t, 2, len(a.Findings))
	uassert.Equal(t, 64, a.Findings[0].Line)

	r, _ := GetRequest(reqID)
	uassert.Equal(t, "attested", r.Status)
	uassert.Equal(t, a.ID, r.Attestation)
	uassert.Equal(t, 0, len(OpenRequests(10)))

	// A request closed without a new attestation (unchanged source) points
	// at the package's latest one.
	testing.SetRealm(testing.NewUserRealm(alice))
	reqID2 := RequestScan(cross(cur), "gno.land/r/demo/vault")
	testing.SetRealm(testing.NewUserRealm(botAddr))
	CloseRequest(cross(cur), reqID2, "Unchanged since its latest attestation.")
	r2, _ := GetRequest(reqID2)
	uassert.Equal(t, "closed", r2.Status)
	uassert.Equal(t, a.ID, r2.Attestation)
	uassert.Equal(t, 2, totalFindings)
	uassert.Equal(t, 2, totalProven)

	// A re-scan replaces the totals for that package.
	attest(cur, "gno.land/r/demo/vault", hash("d"), "", "")
	uassert.Equal(t, 0, totalFindings)
	uassert.Equal(t, 2, len(History("gno.land/r/demo/vault")))
	s, _ := Score("gno.land/r/demo/vault")
	uassert.Equal(t, 100, s)
}

func TestDispute(cur realm, t *testing.T) {
	reset()
	addBot(cur)
	pkg := "gno.land/r/demo/clean"
	fund()
	testing.SetRealm(testing.NewUserRealm(bob))
	uassert.AbortsWithMessage(t, cur, "no attestation to dispute", func() { Dispute(cross(cur), pkg, hash("e"), "x") })

	attest(cur, pkg, hash("c"), "", "")
	uassert.True(t, Check(pkg, Strict()))

	fund()
	testing.SetRealm(testing.NewUserRealm(bob))
	uassert.AbortsWithMessage(t, cur, "a dispute needs a report that differs from the attested one", func() {
		Dispute(cross(cur), pkg, hash("c"), "same report")
	})
	testing.SetOriginSend(chain.Coins{{"ugnot", 1}})
	testing.SetRealm(testing.NewUserRealm(bob))
	uassert.AbortsWithMessage(t, cur, "a dispute needs a deposit of exactly 1000000ugnot", func() {
		Dispute(cross(cur), pkg, hash("e"), "cheap")
	})
	fund()
	testing.SetRealm(testing.NewCodeRealm("gno.land/r/demo/middleman"))
	uassert.AbortsWithMessage(t, cur, "file a dispute with a direct call (gnokey maketx call), sending the deposit", func() {
		Dispute(cross(cur), pkg, hash("e"), "from a realm")
	})

	fund()
	testing.SetRealm(testing.NewUserRealm(bob))
	id := Dispute(cross(cur), pkg, hash("e"), "my run finds B01 at vault.gno:12")
	fund()
	testing.SetRealm(testing.NewUserRealm(bob))
	uassert.AbortsWithMessage(t, cur, "you already have an open dispute on this package", func() {
		Dispute(cross(cur), pkg, hash("f"), "again")
	})
	// An open dispute changes no policy by itself; it queues a re-scan.
	uassert.True(t, Check(pkg, Strict()))
	uassert.Equal(t, "1 "+pkg+" "+rest+"\n", OpenDisputesText(10))
	uassert.True(t, strings.Contains(Render("realm/"+pkg), "⏳ open: waiting for a re-scan"))

	testing.SetRealm(testing.NewUserRealm(alice))
	uassert.AbortsWithMessage(t, cur, "attester only", func() { SettleDispute(cross(cur), id, hash("9")) })
	before := balance(bob)
	testing.SetRealm(testing.NewUserRealm(botAddr))
	SettleDispute(cross(cur), id, hash("c")) // the re-scan reproduces the attested report
	uassert.Equal(t, before, balance(bob))   // deposit kept
	uassert.True(t, Check(pkg, Strict()))
	uassert.Equal(t, "", OpenDisputesText(10))
	ds := DisputesFor(pkg)
	urequire.Equal(t, 1, len(ds))
	uassert.Equal(t, DisputeRejected, ds[0].Status)
	uassert.Equal(t, hash("c"), ds[0].RescanHash)
	testing.SetRealm(testing.NewUserRealm(botAddr))
	uassert.AbortsWithMessage(t, cur, "dispute already settled", func() { SettleDispute(cross(cur), id, hash("9")) })

	// Upheld: the re-scan differs. The attestation is marked disputed,
	// Strict fails, Standard does not, and the deposit comes back.
	fund()
	testing.SetRealm(testing.NewUserRealm(bob))
	id2 := Dispute(cross(cur), pkg, hash("e"), "still B01")
	before = balance(bob)
	testing.SetRealm(testing.NewUserRealm(botAddr))
	SettleDispute(cross(cur), id2, hash("9"))
	uassert.Equal(t, before+DisputeDeposit, balance(bob))
	a, _ := Latest(pkg)
	uassert.True(t, a.Disputed)
	uassert.False(t, Check(pkg, Strict()))
	uassert.True(t, Check(pkg, Standard()))
	uassert.False(t, Check(pkg, Custom(0)))
	uassert.True(t, Check(pkg, Custom(0).WithDisputed()))
	page := Render("realm/" + pkg)
	uassert.True(t, strings.Contains(page, "⚠️ **Disputed.**"))
	uassert.True(t, strings.Contains(page, "⚠️ upheld: the re\\-scan"))

	// A new attestation supersedes the disputed one.
	attest(cur, pkg, hash("9"), "", "")
	uassert.True(t, Check(pkg, Strict()))

	// Closing by hand refunds and marks nothing.
	fund()
	testing.SetRealm(testing.NewUserRealm(bob))
	id3 := Dispute(cross(cur), pkg, hash("e"), "third")
	testing.SetRealm(testing.NewUserRealm(alice))
	uassert.AbortsWithMessage(t, cur, "admin or attester only", func() { ResolveDispute(cross(cur), id3, "no") })
	before = balance(bob)
	testing.SetRealm(testing.NewUserRealm(adminAddr))
	ResolveDispute(cross(cur), id3, "package no longer fetchable")
	uassert.Equal(t, before+DisputeDeposit, balance(bob))
	a, _ = Latest(pkg)
	uassert.False(t, a.Disputed)
}

package bouncer

// Guidance is the fix guidance for one rule. It is written once per rule,
// so every Passport says the same thing and it costs nothing per finding.
type Guidance struct {
	Title      string // short name of the bug class
	Severity   string // as the scanner reports it
	Guide      string // security guide sections
	Vulnerable string // the bug, as Gno code (Wanted poster)
	Meaning    string // what the finding means
	Danger     string // why it is dangerous
	Fix        string // what to change
	Example    string // the fixed code, Gno
	Why        string // why the fix works
}

// RuleGuidance returns the guidance for rule, and false for a rule this
// realm has no guidance for yet.
func RuleGuidance(rule string) (Guidance, bool) {
	switch rule {
	case "B01":
		return Guidance{
			Title:      "Getter returns a pointer into state",
			Severity:   SeverityHigh,
			Vulnerable: "var ledger = avl.NewTree() // address -> balance\n\n// Ledger hands out the live tree.\nfunc Ledger() *avl.Tree {\n\treturn ledger\n}\n\n// Any realm, any time:\n//   vault.Ledger().Set(attacker, int64(1_000_000))",
			Guide:      "§5.1, §5.1a",
			Meaning:    "An exported function hands out a pointer to the realm's own state, and the pointed-to type has an exported method that changes it.",
			Danger:     "Readonly taint stops another realm writing fields through the pointer, but not calling methods on it. Any realm can call the mutating method, and the write commits with this realm's authority: balances, owners and counters change with no check at all.",
			Fix:        "Return copies or plain values, never a pointer into package state. Keep mutating methods unexported and reach them only through crossing functions that check the caller.",
			Example:    "type Entry struct {\n\tAddr    address\n\tBalance int64\n}\n\n// Balances returns a copy of the ledger.\nfunc Balances() []Entry {\n\tout := []Entry{}\n\tledger.Iterate(\"\", \"\", func(k string, v any) bool {\n\t\tout = append(out, Entry{address(k), v.(int64)})\n\t\treturn false\n\t})\n\treturn out\n}",
			Why:        "A copy has no path back into the realm's storage, so nothing a caller does to it can reach the real state.",
		}, true
	case "B05":
		return Guidance{
			Title:      "IsUser() guards an OriginSend payment",
			Severity:   SeverityCritical,
			Vulnerable: "func Deposit(cur realm) {\n\tif !cur.Previous().IsUser() { // also true for maketx run\n\t\tpanic(\"users only\")\n\t}\n\tamount := unsafe.OriginSend().AmountOf(\"ugnot\")\n\tcredit(cur.Previous().Address(), amount) // coins may never have arrived\n}",
			Guide:      "§5.5",
			Meaning:    "A payment is credited from `OriginSend()` behind an `IsUser()` check.",
			Danger:     "`IsUser()` is also true for a `maketx run` script. In that case the coins in `OriginSend()` go to the script's own realm, not to this one, so the caller is credited for money this realm never received and can withdraw other users' funds.",
			Fix:        "Accept payments only from a direct call: check `cur.Previous().IsUserCall()` before reading `OriginSend()`.",
			Example:    "func Deposit(cur realm) {\n\tif !cur.IsCurrent() {\n\t\tpanic(\"not current\")\n\t}\n\tif !cur.Previous().IsUserCall() {\n\t\tpanic(\"deposit with maketx call\")\n\t}\n\tamount := unsafe.OriginSend().AmountOf(\"ugnot\")\n\t// credit amount\n}",
			Why:        "`IsUserCall()` is true only for a direct `maketx call`, where the sent coins are guaranteed to land at this realm before it runs.",
		}, true
	case "B03":
		return Guidance{
			Title:      "Caller-supplied callback runs with the realm's authority",
			Severity:   SeverityCritical,
			Vulnerable: "var scores = map[string]int64{}\n\n// Report lets the caller format the live map.\nfunc Report(cur realm, format func(map[string]int64) string) string {\n\treturn format(scores) // a /p/ function runs as this realm here\n}",
			Guide:      "§3C, §5.3",
			Meaning:    "The realm calls a function value its caller passed in, and hands it a map, slice, pointer or other reference.",
			Danger:     "A top-level function from a /p/ package does not switch realms when called, so inside this call it runs as this realm and can write whatever it is handed, such as the live balances map.",
			Fix:        "Do not call caller-supplied functions. If you must, type the callback with a type declared in this realm, which /p/ code cannot name, and hand it a copy.",
			Example:    "type Entry struct {\n\tPlayer string\n\tPoints int64\n}\n\nfunc Report(cur realm, format func(rows []Entry) string) string {\n\tif !cur.IsCurrent() {\n\t\tpanic(\"not current\")\n\t}\n\treturn format(copyRows())\n}",
			Why:        "A /p/ package cannot import a realm, so it cannot supply a func([]Entry); a function from another realm, or a closure, runs under its own realm and cannot write this realm's data.",
		}, true
	case "B04":
		return Guidance{
			Title:      "unsafe.PreviousRealm() in a crossing function",
			Severity:   SeverityMedium,
			Guide:      "§5.8",
			Vulnerable: "import \"chain/runtime/unsafe\"\n\nfunc Sign(cur realm) {\n\tsigner := unsafe.PreviousRealm().Address() // skips the frame check\n\tsigners = append(signers, signer)\n}",
			Meaning:    "A crossing function takes its caller from `unsafe.PreviousRealm()` instead of `cur.Previous()`.",
			Danger:     "`cur` is the capability the runtime minted for this exact call frame; `unsafe.PreviousRealm()` bypasses the `cur.IsCurrent()` frame verification that makes `cur.Previous()` trustworthy, so caller identity rests on an unchecked API.",
			Fix:        "Check `cur.IsCurrent()`, then take the caller from `cur.Previous()`.",
			Example:    "func Sign(cur realm) {\n\tif !cur.IsCurrent() {\n\t\tpanic(\"not current\")\n\t}\n\tsigners = append(signers, cur.Previous().Address())\n}",
			Why:        "`cur.IsCurrent()` proves `cur` belongs to this frame, so `cur.Previous()` is the realm that really called.",
		}, true
	case "B08":
		return Guidance{
			Title:      "A realm value stored in state",
			Severity:   SeverityMedium,
			Guide:      "§5.7",
			Vulnerable: "var lastVisitor realm\n\nfunc Visit(cur realm) {\n\tlastVisitor = cur.Previous() // cannot be persisted\n}",
			Meaning:    "A `realm` value is written into a package variable, a field or a map.",
			Danger:     "Realm values are tied to one call frame and cannot be persisted: the transaction panics at finalize, so the function always fails, and anything that depends on it is stuck.",
			Fix:        "Store the realm's `Address()` or `PkgPath()`, which are plain values.",
			Example:    "var lastVisitor address\n\nfunc Visit(cur realm) {\n\tif !cur.IsCurrent() {\n\t\tpanic(\"not current\")\n\t}\n\tlastVisitor = cur.Previous().Address()\n}",
			Why:        "An address is plain data: it can be stored and compared across transactions.",
		}, true
	case "B10":
		return Guidance{
			Title:      "Imports the test20 test token",
			Severity:   SeverityCritical,
			Guide:      "§4",
			Vulnerable: "import \"gno.land/r/tests/vm/test20\"\n\nfunc IsVIP(addr address) bool {\n\treturn test20.Token.BalanceOf(addr) >= 1000\n}\n\n// Anyone, any time:\n//   test20.PrivateLedger.Mint(attacker, 1000)",
			Meaning:    "The package imports `gno.land/r/tests/vm/test20`, a token made for tests.",
			Danger:     "test20 exports its `PrivateLedger` on purpose, so anyone can mint, burn or move its balances. Anything that counts test20 balances can be faked.",
			Fix:        "Use a real token, or create your own with `gno.land/p/nt/grc20` and keep its `*PrivateLedger` in a lowercase variable.",
			Example:    "var (\n\ttoken  *grc20.Token\n\tledger *grc20.PrivateLedger // lowercase: only this realm mints\n)\n\nfunc init(cur realm) {\n\ttoken, ledger = grc20.NewToken(\"Lounge\", \"LNG\", 4, 0, cur)\n}",
			Why:        "Only this realm can reach its own ledger, so only it can mint.",
		}, true
	case "B09":
		return Guidance{
			Title:    "External Teller used without IsCanonicalTeller",
			Severity: SeverityHigh,
			Guide:    "§5.4",
			Meaning:  "The realm calls a GRC20 Teller that a caller passed in, without checking it.",
			Danger:   "A fake Teller can report transfers that never happened.",
			Fix:      "Check `grc20.IsCanonicalTeller(t)` before using a Teller from a caller, or look the token up yourself.",
			Example:  "",
			Why:      "A canonical Teller is the token's own, so its transfers are real.",
		}, true
	}
	return Guidance{}, false
}

// Anyone can file disputes. Before the per-package index, Check() walked
// every dispute ever filed, so disputes on other packages made Check() on
// any package cost more, inside integrators' transactions (300 of them:
// 0.7M -> 14.8M gas).
func TestDisputesOnOtherPackagesDoNotReachCheck(cur realm, t *testing.T) {
	reset()
	addBot(cur)
	attest(cur, "gno.land/r/demo/target", hash("c"), "", "")
	attest(cur, "gno.land/r/demo/other", hash("c"), "", "")
	for i := 0; i < 12; i++ {
		fund()
		testing.SetRealm(testing.NewUserRealm(testutils.TestAddress("spam" + strconv.Itoa(i))))
		Dispute(cross(cur), "gno.land/r/demo/other", hash("e"), "spam <gno-form exec=\"TransferAdmin\"> [x](https://evil)")
	}
	uassert.True(t, Check("gno.land/r/demo/target", Strict()))
	uassert.True(t, Check("gno.land/r/demo/other", Strict())) // open disputes alone change nothing
	uassert.Equal(t, 0, OpenDisputes("gno.land/r/demo/target"))
	uassert.Equal(t, 0, len(DisputesFor("gno.land/r/demo/target")))
	uassert.Equal(t, 12, OpenDisputes("gno.land/r/demo/other"))
	uassert.Equal(t, 12, len(DisputesFor("gno.land/r/demo/other")))

	// The Passport lists only the newest 10, and escapes the notes.
	page := Render("realm/gno.land/r/demo/other")
	uassert.True(t, strings.Contains(page, "12 open of 12 filed. The newest 10 are shown."))
	uassert.Equal(t, 10, strings.Count(page, "spam \\<gno\\-form exec="))
	uassert.False(t, strings.Contains(page, "<gno-form exec=\"TransferAdmin\""))
	uassert.False(t, strings.Contains(page, "](https://evil)"))
}

func TestDisputeBookkeeping(cur realm, t *testing.T) {
	reset()
	addBot(cur)
	attest(cur, "gno.land/r/demo/vault", hash("c"), "", "")
	fund()
	testing.SetRealm(testing.NewUserRealm(alice))
	id1 := Dispute(cross(cur), "gno.land/r/demo/vault", hash("e"), "first")
	fund()

	id2 := Dispute(cross(cur), "gno.land/r/demo/vault", hash("e"), "second")
	uassert.Equal(t, 2, OpenDisputes("gno.land/r/demo/vault"))
	uassert.Equal(t, "1 gno.land/r/demo/vault "+rest+"\n2 gno.land/r/demo/vault "+rest+"\n", OpenDisputesText(10))

	testing.SetRealm(testing.NewUserRealm(alice)) // alice may file again

	testing.SetRealm(testing.NewUserRealm(botAddr))
	SettleDispute(cross(cur), id2, hash("c"))

// Anyone can open requests (one per address). Before the per-package index,
// every Attest walked all open requests (300 of them: 2.8M -> 34.9M gas).
func TestAttestClosesOnlyItsOwnRequests(cur realm, t *testing.T) {
	reset()
	addBot(cur)
	for i := 0; i < 5; i++ {
		testing.SetRealm(testing.NewUserRealm(testutils.TestAddress("req" + strconv.Itoa(i))))
		RequestScan(cross(cur), "gno.land/r/demo/other"+strconv.Itoa(i))
	}
	testing.SetRealm(testing.NewUserRealm(alice))
	a := RequestScan(cross(cur), "gno.land/r/demo/vault")
	testing.SetRealm(testing.NewUserRealm(bob))
	b := RequestScan(cross(cur), "gno.land/r/demo/vault")
	testing.SetRealm(testing.NewUserRealm(bob))
	CancelRequest(cross(cur))
	testing.SetRealm(testing.NewUserRealm(bob))
	c := RequestScan(cross(cur), "gno.land/r/demo/vault")

	attest(cur, "gno.land/r/demo/vault", hash("c"), "", "")
	uassert.Equal(t, 5, len(OpenRequests(100)))
	for _, r := range OpenRequests(100) {
		uassert.True(t, strings.HasPrefix(r.PkgPath, "gno.land/r/demo/other"))
	}
	ra, _ := GetRequest(a)
	rb, _ := GetRequest(b)
	rc, _ := GetRequest(c)
	uassert.Equal(t, "attested", ra.Status)
	uassert.Equal(t, "cancelled", rb.Status) // not re-closed
	uassert.Equal(t, "attested", rc.Status)
	uassert.Equal(t, nil, openByPkg.Get("gno.land/r/demo/vault")) // emptied index is dropped

	// Closing by hand keeps the index in step too.
	testing.SetRealm(testing.NewUserRealm(botAddr))
	CloseRequest(cross(cur), 1, "package not found")
	attest(cur, "gno.land/r/demo/other0", hash("c"), "", "")
	uassert.Equal(t, 4, len(OpenRequests(100)))
}
